feed.title: Basic Pitches
feed.subtitle: "Basic Pitches" is an improvisional theatre company that grows & performs in Zurich, Switzerland. Despite not having a single native speaker, we proudly perform in English with a wide variety accents and oddities.

entry.title: BASIC PITCHES - My Big Hilarious Greek Tragedy

link.title: BASIC PITCHES - My Big Hilarious Greek Tragedy

entry.content:
The gods have spoken — the Basic Pitches are back! And this time, we’re going full Greek. 🍇🎤

The improvised musicals season starts with a toga-worthy bang! (Yes — we’re back from the summer pause and ready to belt out drama like the ancient legends we are.)

💥 FREE ENTRY IF YOU WEAR A TOGA!

Stay for the after party — the bar’s open till late! 🕺🍷

Expect epic drama, divine comedy, and maybe a tragic goat or two 🐐 Don’t miss this legendary night of musical improv mayhem!

entry.title: Double feature - Basic Pitches + Stuba Productions

link.title: Double feature - Basic Pitches + Stuba Productions

entry.content:
Step into a world of glitter, glamour, and completely improvised fun in this sparkling double feature!

First up, Woop-De-Doo by Stubä Productions, a playful improvised story inspired by a word from the audience. It’s quirky, curious, and not to be taken too seriously. Woop-de-doo!

Then the night takes a fabulous turn as the Basic Pitches present Moulimprov Rouge, a dazzling mix of unscripted scenes and spontaneous songs, all with a touch of Parisian flair. It’s a whirlwind of romance, comedy, and cabaret, where everything is made up and absolutely anything can happen!
entry.summary: Step into a world of glitter, glamour, and completely improvised fun in this sparkling double feature!

entry.title: Double feature - Basic Pitches + Milquetoast
entry.content:
Serving you up a double helping of English Improv with a double feature! Two improv groups will take the stage:

  • Basic Pitches: A musical show like no other! Basic Pitches will improvise an entire musical, complete with chart topping songs, from a few audience suggestions. Not to be missed!

  • Milquetoast: Fascinating long form improv inspired from audience suggestions.

entry.title: Halloween Musical
entry.content:
Get ready for a frightfully fun night of improvised musical comedy!

Our talented improvisers will conjure up a spine-chilling musical based entirely on your spooky suggestions. Expect ghostly ballads, zombie rock anthems, and more undead delights.

  • Basic Pitches: A musical show like no other! Basic Pitches will improvise an entire musical, complete with chart topping songs, from a few audience suggestions. Not to be missed!

  • Rio: A duo show exploring therapy and relationships.
